inbox.emptyDescription: Mail sent to the addresses you add appears here.

setup.title: Set up MelodyMail
setup.tokenDescription: Enter the SETUP_TOKEN secret you set for this Worker.
setup.passkeyDescription: Create a passkey on this device. You use it to sign in.
setup.totpDescription: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the secret key by hand. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the passkey you created during setup.
login.recoverLink: Can't use your passkey? Use your recovery key

recover.title: Recover access
recover.description: Enter your recovery key and a code from your authenticator app.
recover.addPasskeyDescription: Register a passkey on this device so you can sign in without your recovery key.
recover.newKeyNotice: Your old recovery key no longer works. Store this one somewhere safe. Then add a new passkey within 30 minutes; after that, adding one asks you to confirm with a passkey you may no longer have.

recoveryKey.shownOnce: This key is shown only once
recoveryKey.setupNotice: With a code from your authenticator app, it lets you sign in if you lose your passkeys. Store it somewhere safe.
recoveryKey.rotatedNotice: Your old recovery key no longer works. Store this one somewhere safe.
recoveryKey.confirm: I have saved my recovery key

security.title: Security
security.passkeysDescription: Passkeys sign you in to MelodyMail.
security.lastPasskey: This is your only passkey. Add another one before you remove it.
security.removeDescription: You can no longer sign in with this passkey.
security.sessionsDescription: Browsers that are signed in to MelodyMail.
security.signOutOthersDescription: Every browser except this one is signed out.
security.signOutDescription: End the session in this browser.
security.loadFailed: Security settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
security.recoveryKeyDescription: With a code from your authenticator app, it signs you in if you lose your passkeys.
security.regenerateKeyDescription: Your current recovery key stops working. The new key is shown once.

errors.network: MelodyMail could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
errors.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use a current browser.
errors.already_initialized: MelodyMail is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_setup_token: The setup token is wrong. Check the SETUP_TOKEN secret and try again.
errors.setup_disabled: Setup is turned off. Set a SETUP_TOKEN secret of at least 32 characters, then try again.
errors.verification_failed: That did not work. Check what you entered and try again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.last_passkey: You cannot remove your only passkey. Add another one first.
errors.reauth_required: Confirm with your passkey to continue.
errors.invalid_domain: This is not a valid domain name. Check it and try again.
errors.domain_not_ascii: Enter an internationalized domain in its xn-- form.
errors.domain_has_addresses: This domain still has addresses. Delete them first, or confirm deleting them with the domain.
errors.dns_check_failed: DNS could not be checked right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_local_part: Use only letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, without a dot at the start or end.
errors.unknown_domain: Choose a domain that is added in Domains.
errors.unknown_target: A forwarding address was removed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forward_only_needs_target: Choose at least one forwarding address, or turn off Forward only.
errors.invalid_note: The note is too long. Use at most 200 characters.
errors.invalid_display_name: The sender name is too long or has a line break. Use at most 100 characters on one line.
errors.invalid_email: This is not a valid email address. Check it and try again.
errors.target_exists: This forwarding address is already added.
errors.target_in_use: Addresses still forward to this address. Confirm removing it from them.

settingsPage.loadFailed: This page could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

domains.title: Domains
domains.name: Domain
domains.nameDescription: The domain must use Cloudflare DNS with Email Routing turned on. Enter an internationalized domain in its xn-- form.
domains.emptyDescription: Add a domain you manage in Cloudflare to receive mail at its addresses.
domains.removeDescription: MelodyMail stops accepting mail for this domain. Your DNS records are not changed.
domains.removeWithAddresses: Its addresses ({{count}}) are deleted too, and mail to them is refused. This cannot be undone.

dns.title: DNS records for {{name}}
dns.receiveDescription: Turning on Email Routing for the domain in the Cloudflare dashboard adds the MX and SPF records. If the domain already has an SPF record, add the include to it; a domain must have only one SPF record.
dns.name: Name

hint.mx: All three hosts, and no other MX record. Cloudflare sets the priorities.
hint.spf: One SPF record that contains include:_spf.mx.cloudflare.net.
hint.dmarc: Any DMARC policy. Start with p=none and tighten it once mail flows.

dns.sendDescription: Sending arrives in a later version. When you add the domain in the Resend dashboard, Resend shows the exact records to publish.
dns.fromResend: Copy it from the Resend dashboard

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.localPartDescription: Letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores. + is reserved for tags such as shop+news.
addresses.displayNameDescription: The name shown to recipients when you send from this address.
addresses.enabledDescription: When off, mail to this address is refused.
addresses.targetsDescription: Each message is forwarded to every address you select.
addresses.forwardOnlyDescription: Forward messages without keeping a copy in MelodyMail. Needs at least one forwarding address.
addresses.emptyDescription: Only the addresses you add here receive mail; mail to any other address is refused.
addresses.emptyNoDomain: Add a domain first, then add the addresses that receive mail on it.
addresses.removeDescription: Mail to this address is refused from now on. This cannot be undone.

forwarding.title: Forwarding
forwarding.emailDescription: It must be a verified destination address in Cloudflare.
forwarding.verifyTitle: Verify each forwarding address in Cloudflare first
forwarding.verifyDescription: In the Cloudflare dashboard, go to Email Routing > Destination addresses, add the address and confirm the verification email. An account can have up to 200. Forwarding to an unverified address fails when mail arrives.
forwarding.emptyDescription: Add an address that mail can be forwarded to, then choose it on an address.
forwarding.removeDescription: No mail is forwarded to this address any more.
forwarding.removeInUse: It is removed from the addresses that forward to it ({{count}}). This cannot be undone.
